item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":91,"end_unit":92,"fact_summary":"In the first half of 2023, Germany used the accelerated asylum procedure for 313 applications, equal to 0.2% of applications; its average duration was 5.7 months, only modestly shorter than the 6.8-month average for all procedures in 2023.","question_ids":["8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly concerns 2023; the report also provides comparative 2022 figures.","ruler_attribution":"The federal government and BAMF operated the statutory procedure during Scholz's chancellorship; implementation also depended on BAMF branch offices and the Länder.","limitations":["The source does not attribute the operational result personally to Scholz.","The accelerated-procedure statistics cover only the first half of 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":92,"end_unit":94,"fact_summary":"Germany revised BAMF vulnerability-identification guidance in 2022 and used internal 2023 guidelines, but the Asylum Act still lacked clear duties to provide adequate support; NGOs and a federal working group continued to report that identification was not systematic, and the federal government did not systematically monitor implementation by the Länder.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","6B.3","6B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The institutional finding and 2023 criticism apply during the target year, although some reforms predate 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The federal government and BAMF established the guidance and monitoring framework; reception implementation was substantially assigned to the Länder.","limitations":["The source reports NGO and working-group assessments rather than a nationwide outcome evaluation.","The report does not isolate decisions personally made by Scholz."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":92,"end_unit":92,"fact_summary":"From 1 January 2023, BAMF provided additional federal funding for independent counsellors supporting vulnerable asylum seekers, with consent-based information sharing with BAMF and Länder authorities.","question_ids":["3B.7","6B.2","6B.3","6B.9","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly concerns a 2023 policy and funding change.","ruler_attribution":"The federal government and BAMF implemented the funding arrangement under the coalition government led by Scholz.","limitations":["The source provides no quantified coverage or outcome data for the new funding in 2023.","Funding did not itself establish a comprehensive statutory identification system."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":94,"end_unit":95,"fact_summary":"Federal guidance on identifying vulnerable asylum seekers was not legally binding, and the federal government did not systematically monitor whether the Länder implemented it; procedures varied considerably among arrival and reception centres.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","4B.4","6B.5","8B.5"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The finding was reported in 2023 and describes the institutional position during the target year.","ruler_attribution":"The federal government retained guidance and oversight responsibilities, while the Länder controlled much reception-centre implementation.","limitations":["The source does not quantify the resulting harm across the population.","The finding concerns federal-Länder administration rather than a personal directive by Scholz."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":96,"end_unit":98,"fact_summary":"In 2023, critics reported that discretionary age assessments often classified unaccompanied children as adults and that affected children lacked sufficient access to legal remedies; objections and appeals did not automatically suspend the custody or asylum consequences.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.7","3B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns criticism and legal operation reported in 2023, while some governing rules predate the year.","ruler_attribution":"The federal legal framework and youth-welfare administration operated during Scholz's chancellorship; age assessment was implemented by local youth welfare offices.","limitations":["The source reports criticism and procedural rules, not a nationally representative error rate for 2023.","The relevant authorities were primarily local and Länder institutions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":98,"end_unit":99,"fact_summary":"By June 2023, BAMF had 1,267 staff members serving as special officers for vulnerable applicants; their roles covered unaccompanied children, gender-specific persecution, trauma or torture, and trafficking, with 410 officers qualified for unaccompanied-children cases.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.7","4B.5","6B.4","8B.4"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly concerns staffing and institutional capacity in June 2023.","ruler_attribution":"BAMF recruited, trained, and deployed the special officers under the federal government during Scholz's chancellorship.","limitations":["Some officers held multiple specialisations, so the category totals cannot be summed.","The source does not show whether staffing was sufficient for workload or whether outcomes improved nationwide."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":98,"end_unit":99,"fact_summary":"Lawyers reported some improvement from BAMF special officers, but cases were documented in which trauma or explicit torture references did not trigger consultation; BAMF did not record how often special officers were consulted or took over cases.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.7","6B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The institutional assessment and reporting concern the 2023 operating context.","ruler_attribution":"BAMF was responsible for the procedure and recordkeeping under the federal government led by Scholz.","limitations":["The source gives examples and professional criticism rather than a systematic failure rate.","The lack of consultation data limits outcome assessment."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":99,"end_unit":100,"fact_summary":"German law did not exempt unaccompanied children or other persons needing special procedural guarantees from airport procedures, despite the EU requirement for exemptions; in practice, accompanied minors were subjected to the airport procedure, including 72 children in 2022.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.7","3B.9","4B.4"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The legal shortcoming remained operative during 2023; the cited child count is for 2022.","ruler_attribution":"The federal legislature and BAMF operated the framework during Scholz's chancellorship.","limitations":["The quantitative example is from 2022, not 2023.","The report notes some de facto protection for recognised unaccompanied minors despite the statutory gap."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":103,"end_unit":104,"fact_summary":"In 2023, unaccompanied children could remain in preliminary youth-welfare care for up to eight months because of local-authority overload, receiving only emergency psychological assistance, limited legal representation and youth-care services, and often no school enrollment; guardians could be responsible for up to 50 minors and were reported to lack sufficient capacity or expertise.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.4","8B.5"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns conditions reported in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The federal legal framework operated through overloaded municipal and Länder youth-welfare systems during Scholz's chancellorship.","limitations":["The source does not establish that Scholz personally caused the local capacity shortages.","The ‘up to eight months’ and workload figures describe reported cases and administrative conditions, not a national average."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":108,"end_unit":110,"fact_summary":"In December 2023, the federal government added Georgia and Moldova to Germany's statutory safe-country-of-origin list after parliamentary and Bundesrat action; Greens raised concerns, while NGOs and opposition critics disputed whether both countries were safe.","question_ids":["3B.7","4B.1","4B.4","4B.7","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly concerns a measure enacted in December 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The federal government proposed and secured the designation under the coalition led by Scholz; Parliament and Bundesrat participated in enactment.","limitations":["The source records disagreement about safety but does not adjudicate the underlying country conditions.","The measure was institutionally enacted, but implementation outcomes are not evaluated here."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":113,"end_unit":116,"fact_summary":"From January 2023, Germany replaced state-run individual asylum counselling with federally financed independent counselling by welfare or civil-society organizations and budgeted €20 million for 2023; funding was disbursed only in summer, associations said the amount was insufficient, and staffing could be as low as two full-time counsellors for 600 applicants at one centre.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.7","4B.3","6B.2","6B.4","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly concerns the 2023 reform, budget, and implementation.","ruler_attribution":"The federal coalition government enacted the reform and provided the funding; BAMF administered the funding process, while civil-society groups delivered counselling.","limitations":["The source does not provide nationwide 2023 uptake figures.","The staffing example is from one centre and cannot be generalized without further evidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":116,"end_unit":118,"fact_summary":"In 2023, the Federal Administrative Court held that welfare associations had to be granted access to reception centres for individually requested counselling, but authorities were not required to provide open regular access; the report concluded that funding, coordination and legal uncertainty prevented guaranteed individual counselling nationwide.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.8","4B.3","6B.2","6B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns a 2023 court decision and implementation assessment.","ruler_attribution":"The federal legal and funding framework operated under Scholz, while the court independently interpreted access rights and local authorities controlled facility access.","limitations":["The court finding limits attribution to the executive.","The conclusion about nationwide access is an assessment based on reported institutional barriers, not a complete administrative census."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":121,"end_unit":124,"fact_summary":"Germany's federal Afghan humanitarian admission programme selected 229 people by 30 June 2023, but only 13 had entered Germany by October; the programme was paused in March over alleged misuse, the government said there was no evidence of systemic abuse, and it restarted on 26 June after additional security screening was introduced.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","6B.3","8B.6","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly concerns programme decisions and implementation during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The federal government, Interior Ministry, Foreign Office and security agencies operated the programme under Scholz's chancellorship.","limitations":["The source reports allegations and the government's rebuttal but does not independently determine whether misuse occurred.","The admission numbers reflect implementation through October 2023, not the entire programme period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":123,"end_unit":124,"fact_summary":"After the Afghan admission programme resumed, 99 security-screening interviews were conducted between 26 June and 21 July 2023 and no security concerns were identified; the government reported expanded capacity to conduct several hundred screenings per month by August.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.7","6B.3","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly concerns programme safeguards and capacity in mid-2023.","ruler_attribution":"Federal security agencies and the responsible ministries implemented the screening system under the Scholz government.","limitations":["The sample is small and early; absence of identified concerns does not establish long-term security effectiveness.","The capacity figure is a government-reported estimate."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":124,"end_unit":125,"fact_summary":"NGOs criticized the Afghan admission programme in 2023 for slow implementation, opaque selection, restrictive agency-based nomination and IT procedures, inadequate staffing, passport barriers, and failure to meet the originally envisaged 1,000 admissions per month.","question_ids":["3B.7","6B.3","6B.4","6B.5","8B.6","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns implementation criticism during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The federal government designed and administered the programme; NGOs assessed its implementation and called for correction.","limitations":["These are NGO criticisms and demands, not independently verified measures of every alleged defect.","The source does not establish the causal contribution of Scholz personally."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The source is a country report covering Germany's asylum and protection system; most facts concern federal ministries, BAMF, courts, Länder or municipalities rather than Olaf Scholz personally.","The report contains both 2023 evidence and historical or 2022 comparisons; period fit is stated for each record.","No fact is scored."]}
